_comment: Raspberry Pi stand-in (Venus v3.x, gs_usb CAN adapter): /data/huawei/driver.json. interface 'gs_usb:1' = channel 2 of the USB adapter (dev_id 1), whatever name the kernel gave it; channel 1 (dev_id 0) is the Pylontech BMS link and is never touched. scales/names/excluded as on the Cerbo (see driver.json). No display block: the optional repeater is not used here. 2026-11-19: Huawei 1 is now the new DMA-48-75 E03085905E7C (replaces the retired R4875G5 708A85B00972, excluded); its current scale stays unbound until a load test.
